subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should docs.openclaw.ai track latest stable releases by default, stay latest-main with explicit availability markers, or rely on bundled version-matched docs for release-specific guidance?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but the durable fix changes docs publishing and recovery policy rather than one local code path.

options.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
options.body: Publish or label docs so config keys cannot appear as generally available before the release that accepts them.

options.title: Keep latest-main docs with recovery
options.body: Keep the live site on main but add prominent version markers plus version-aware validation or Doctor recovery for unsupported documented keys.

options.title: Defer to bundled docs
options.body: Treat the bundled local docs track as the release-specific guidance path while keeping the live site as latest-main.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
recommendation.body: Publish or label docs so config keys cannot appear as generally available before the release that accepts them.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing candidate from recent docs publish workflow and source-grounded docs history, and the decision is primarily docs/release policy.
